test_pillar_feature_net: test the PillarFeatureNet voxel encoder by building it from config and running random feature tensors through it
test_hard_simple_VFE: test the HardSimpleVFE voxel encoder by building it from config and verifying output tensor shape
build_voxel_encoder_pillar: build a PillarFeatureNet voxel encoder using build_voxel_encoder with a config dict specifying in_channels and feat_channels
build_voxel_encoder_hard_simple: build a HardSimpleVFE voxel encoder using build_voxel_encoder with a config dict specifying num_features
run_voxel_encoder_forward: run a voxel encoder forward pass with features, num_voxels, and coors tensors to extract pillar features
